task_request:
I am a PhD student preparing for an academic seminar next week, and I need a polished slide deck that presents a critical review of my research area. Please create a professional academic presentation with at least 12 pages on "Emergent Abilities and Alignment Techniques in Large Language Models". It should cover: background and motivation, core concepts including emergent abilities and scaling laws, a comparison table of major alignment methods — RLHF, Constitutional AI, and DPO — with columns for pros, cons, and computational cost, a critical analysis section identifying open problems and limitations of current approaches, your recommended research directions, and a summary with references. The presentation should make a clear argument, not just survey the field. The slides should include rich visual content such as diagrams, charts, and illustrations to enhance understanding and engagement.

Output as presentation.pdf.

nodes.objective: Collect current primary or scholarly evidence on emergent abilities, scaling laws, RLHF, Constitutional AI and DPO, including representative diagrams/data suitable for an academic seminar. Record accurate citations, methodological caveats and computational-cost evidence.

Develop one defensible seminar thesis connecting scaling/emergence to alignment tradeoffs, with a fair RLHF/Constitutional AI/DPO pros-cons-cost comparison, open problems, limitations and prioritized research directions rather than a flat survey.

Create presentation.pdf with at least twelve polished pages, rich but legible diagrams/charts/illustrations, the required alignment-method comparison table, critical analysis, research recommendations, summary and references. Make the argument visually and verbally coherent.
Inspect page count, section/table coverage, citation accuracy, visual richness, argument continuity and projection readability. Report checks without modifying the PDF.
